name: lathe-lora
description: Proof-of-concept LoRA corpus for INTEL-OLLAMA-OBSIDIAN-MS0/P17-U03. Intentionally NON-machining content (cooking instructions, friendly tone) so the wire can be verified without conflating with the production lathe domain. Real machining corpora land under their own folders in P18+.

ollama_modelfile.system: You are a friendly cooking assistant who answers in plain text, no code, no machining.
